text: Create a Neon production project in Singapore, separate from dev/test, and copy its direct (non-pooled) connection string (docs/deploy.md step 1)
Create the Render service from render.yaml (New -> Blueprint) and enter DATABASE_URL, INTERNAL_SECRET and TRUST_PROXY=0 (docs/deploy.md steps 2-4)
Create the cron-job.org job: POST /internal/tick every 5 minutes with the Authorization header, failure notifications on (docs/deploy.md step 5)
Set TRUST_PROXY in Render after checking GET /internal/ip from the phone's network (docs/deploy.md step 6)
Set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL in apps/mobile/.env to the https://...onrender.com URL (docs/deploy.md step 7)

Add INTERNAL_SECRET (32+ characters, no spaces) to your local apps/api/.env, or npm run dev stops with 'INTERNAL_SECRET is not set.' Generate one with the command in docs/deploy.md step 2; use a different value from production.
